title: प्रधानमन्त्री शाह र भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री मोदीद्वारा संयुक्त रूपमा जनकपुरधाम–अयोध्या रेलवे सेवा उद्घाटन
content:
No ads found for this position नयाँ दिल्ली । प्रधानमन्त्री वालेन्द्र शाह र भारतका प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीले जनकपुरधाम–अयोध्याबीच सञ्चालन हुने रेल सेवाको संयुक्त रूपमा उद्घाटन गरेका छन् । भारतको राजकीय भ्रमणमा रहेका प्रधानमन्त्री शाह र भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री मोदीले आज भर्चुअल माध्यमबाट झण्डा फहराएर रेल सेवाको उद्घाटन गरेका हुन् । अयोध्याबाट जनकपुरधामसम्मको करिब ६०४ किलोमिटर दूरी रेलमार्फत करिब १९ घण्टामा पूरा हुनेछ । उत्तर प्रदेश र बिहारका विभिन्न सहर हुँदै सञ्चालन हुने यो रेल सेवाले धार्मिक पर्यटन प्रवर्द्धन गर्नुका साथै दुई देशबीचको सीमापार आवागमन सहज बनाउने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । ‘जनकपुरधाम–अयोध्या क्यान्ट एक्सप्रेस’ नाम दिइएको रेल भारतको बिहारस्थित जयनगर रेल्वे स्टेसन हुँदै नेपाल प्रवेश गर्नेछ । रेलले जनकपुरधाम, जयनगर, मधुबनी, सिशो, सीतामढी, रक्सौल, नरकटियागञ्ज, गोरखपुर, बस्ती, मनकापुर, अयोध्या धाम र अयोध्या क्यान्ट स्टेसनमा यात्रु चढाउने तथा ओराल्नेछ । रेल सेवा सातामा एक दिन दुवैतर्फ सञ्चालन हुनेछ । जनकपुरधामबाट अयोध्या क्यान्टसम्म जाने रेलको नम्बर १५५९५ र अयोध्या क्यान्टबाट जनकपुरधाम आउने रेलको नम्बर १५५९६ निर्धारण गरिएको छ । जनकपुरधामबाट अयोध्या जाने रेल शनिबार दिउँसो १ः१० बजे प्रस्थान गरी आइतबार बिहान अयोध्या क्यान्ट पुग्ने तालिका छ । त्यस्तै, अयोध्या क्यान्टबाट सोमबार साँझ ५ः५० बजे प्रस्थान गर्ने रेल मंगलबार दिउँसो १२ः४० बजे जनकपुरधाम पुग्नेछ । नेपालका रेल स्टेसनमा तोकिएका समय भारतीय समयभन्दा १५ मिनेट अगाडि हुने भएकाले यात्रुले स्थानीय समयअनुसार तालिका हेर्नुपर्नेछ । अयोध्या भगवान् रामको जन्मस्थल र जनकपुरधाम माता सीताको जन्मस्थलका रूपमा धार्मिक महत्त्व बोकेका स्थान हुन् । नयाँ रेल सेवाबाट धार्मिक पर्यटक, आफन्त भेटघाटका लागि यात्रा गर्ने व्यक्ति, विद्यार्थी र व्यवसायी लाभान्वित हुनुका साथै पर्यटन व्यवसायमा समेत टेवा पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । यसअघि भारतबाट रेलमार्फत जनकपुरधाम जाने यात्रुले बिहारको जयनगर पुगेर सीमासम्बन्धी प्रक्रिया पूरा गरेपछि नेपालतर्फको रेल परिवर्तन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो । नयाँ सेवाबाट आवश्यक सीमासम्बन्धी जाँच पूरा गरेपछि एउटै रेलमा यात्रा जारी राख्न सकिने सुविधा उपलब्ध हुने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । New Delhi: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have jointly inaugurated the Janakpurdham-Ayodhya rail service. Prime Minister Shah and Indian Prime Minister Modi, who are on a state visit to India, inaugurated the rail service today by hoisting the flag virtually. The 604-kilometer distance from Ayodhya to Janakpurdham will be covered by train in about 19 hours. The train service, which will operate through various cities in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, is expected to promote religious tourism and facilitate cross-border movement between the two countries. The train, named 'Janakpurdham-Ayodhya Cantt Express', will enter Nepal via Jayanagar Railway Station in Bihar, India. The train will pick up and drop off passengers at Janakpurdham, Jayanagar, Madhubani, Sisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiyagunj, Gorakhpur, Basti, Mankapur, Ayodhya Dham and Ayodhya Cantt stations. The train service will operate in both directions once a week. The train number for Janakpurdham to Ayodhya Cantt is 15595 and the train number for Ayodhya Cantt to Janakpurdham is 15596. The train from Janakpurdham to Ayodhya is scheduled to depart at 1:10 pm on Saturday and reach Ayodhya Cantt on Sunday morning. Similarly, the train departing from Ayodhya Cantt at 5:50 pm on Monday will reach Janakpurdham at 12:40 pm on Tuesday. Since the timings at Nepalese railway stations are 15 minutes ahead of Indian time, passengers will need to check the schedule according to local time. Ayodhya is the birthplace of Lord Ram and Janakpur is the birthplace of Goddess Sita, both of which hold religious significance. The new train service is expected to benefit religious tourists, relatives, students, and businessmen, as well as boost the tourism industry. Previously, there was a provision that passengers traveling from India to Janakpurdham by train had to change trains to Nepal after reaching Jayanagar in Bihar and completing border procedures. The new service is expected to provide the facility to continue traveling on the same train after completing the necessary border checks.

‘जनकपुरधाम–अयोध्या क्यान्ट एक्सप्रेस’ नाम दिइएको रेल भारतको बिहारस्थित जयनगर रेल्वे स्टेसन हुँदै नेपाल प्रवेश गर्नेछ । रेलले जनकपुरधाम, जयनगर, मधुबनी, सिशो, सीतामढी, रक्सौल, नरकटियागञ्ज, गोरखपुर, क्यान्टबाट जनकपुरधाम आउने रेलको नम्बर १५५९६ निर्धारण गरिएको छ । जनकपुरधामबाट अयोध्या जाने रेल शनिबार दिउँसो १ः१० बजे प्रस्थान गरी आइतबार बिहान अयोध्या क्यान्ट पुग्ने तालिका छ । त्यस्तै, अयोध्या क्यान्टबाट सोमबार साँझ ५ः५० बजे प्रस्थान गर्ने रेल मंगलबार दिउँसो १२ः४० बजे जनकपुरधाम पुग्नेछ । नेपालका रेल स्टेसनमा तोकिएका समय भारतीय समयभन्दा १५ मिनेट अगाडि हुने भएकाले यात्रुले स्थानीय समयअनुसार तालिका हेर्नुपर्नेछ । अयोध्या भगवान् रामको जन्मस्थल र जनकपुरधाम माता सीताको जन्मस्थलका रूपमा धार्मिक महत्त्व बोकेका स्थान हुन् । नयाँ रेल सेवाबाट धार्मिक पर्यटक, आफन्त भेटघाटका लागि यात्रा गर्ने व्यक्ति, विद्यार्थी र व्यवसायी लाभान्वित हुनुका साथै पर्यटन व्यवसायमा समेत टेवा पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । यसअघि भारतबाट रेलमार्फत जनकपुरधाम जाने यात्रुले बिहारको जयनगर पुगेर सीमासम्बन्धी प्रक्रिया पूरा गरेपछि नेपालतर्फको रेल परिवर्तन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो । नयाँ सेवाबाट आवश्यक सीमासम्बन्धी जाँच पूरा गरेपछि एउटै रेलमा यात्रा जारी राख्न सकिने सुविधा उपलब्ध हुने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । New Delhi: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have jointly inaugurated the Janakpurdham-Ayodhya rail service. Prime Minister Shah and Indian Prime Minister Modi, who are on a state visit to India, inaugurated the rail service today by hoisting the flag virtually. The 604-kilometer distance from Ayodhya to Janakpurdham will be covered by train in about 19 hours. The train service, which will operate through various cities in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, is expected to promote religious tourism and facilitate cross-border movement between the two countries. The train, named 'Janakpurdham-Ayodhya Cantt Express', will enter Nepal via Jayanagar Railway Station in Bihar, India. The train will pick up and drop off passengers at Janakpurdham, Jayanagar, Madhubani, Sisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiyagunj, Gorakhpur, Basti, Mankapur, Ayodhya Dham and Ayodhya Cantt stations. The train service will operate in both directions once a week. The train number for Janakpurdham to Ayodhya Cantt is 15595 and the train number for Ayodhya Cantt to Janakpurdham is 15596. The train from Janakpurdham to Ayodhya is scheduled to depart at 1:10 pm on Saturday and reach Ayodhya Cantt on Sunday morning. Similarly, the train departing from Ayodhya Cantt at 5:50 pm on Monday will reach Janakpurdham at 12:40 pm on Tuesday. Since the timings at Nepalese railway stations are 15 minutes ahead of Indian time, passengers will need to check the schedule according to local time. Ayodhya is the birthplace of Lord Ram and Janakpur is the birthplace of Goddess Sita, both of which hold religious significance. The new train service is expected to benefit religious tourists, relatives, students, and businessmen, as well as boost the tourism industry. Previously, there was a provision that passengers traveling from India to Janakpurdham by train had to change trains to Nepal after reaching Jayanagar in Bihar and completing border procedures. The new service is expected to provide the facility to continue traveling on the same train after completing the necessary border checks.

‘जनकपुरधाम–अयोध्या क्यान्ट एक्सप्रेस’ नाम दिइएको रेल भारतको बिहारस्थित जयनगर रेल्वे स्टेसन हुँदै नेपाल प्रवेश गर्नेछ । रेलले जनकपुरधाम, जयनगर, मधुबनी, सिशो, सीतामढी, रक्सौल, नरकटियागञ्ज, गोरखपुर, बस्ती, मनकापुर, अयोध्या धाम र अयोध्या क्यान्ट स्टेसनमा यात्रु चढाउने तथा ओराल्नेछ ।

रेल सेवा सातामा एक दिन दुवैतर्फ सञ्चालन हुनेछ । जनकपुरधामबाट अयोध्या क्यान्टसम्म जाने रेलको नम्बर १५५९५ र अयोध्या क्यान्टबाट जनकपुरधाम आउने रेलको नम्बर १५५९६ निर्धारण गरिएको छ ।

जनकपुरधामबाट अयोध्या जाने रेल शनिबार दिउँसो १ः१० बजे प्रस्थान गरी आइतबार बिहान अयोध्या क्यान्ट पुग्ने तालिका छ । त्यस्तै, अयोध्या क्यान्टबाट सोमबार साँझ ५ः५० बजे प्रस्थान गर्ने रेल मंगलबार दिउँसो १२ः४० बजे जनकपुरधाम पुग्नेछ ।

नेपालका रेल स्टेसनमा तोकिएका समय भारतीय समयभन्दा १५ मिनेट अगाडि हुने भएकाले यात्रुले स्थानीय समयअनुसार तालिका हेर्नुपर्नेछ ।

अयोध्या भगवान् रामको जन्मस्थल र जनकपुरधाम माता सीताको जन्मस्थलका रूपमा धार्मिक महत्त्व बोकेका स्थान हुन् । नयाँ रेल सेवाबाट धार्मिक पर्यटक, आफन्त भेटघाटका लागि यात्रा गर्ने व्यक्ति, विद्यार्थी र व्यवसायी लाभान्वित हुनुका साथै पर्यटन व्यवसायमा समेत टेवा पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।

यसअघि भारतबाट रेलमार्फत जनकपुरधाम जाने यात्रुले बिहारको जयनगर पुगेर सीमासम्बन्धी प्रक्रिया पूरा गरेपछि नेपालतर्फको रेल परिवर्तन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो ।

नयाँ सेवाबाट आवश्यक सीमासम्बन्धी जाँच पूरा गरेपछि एउटै रेलमा यात्रा जारी राख्न सकिने सुविधा उपलब्ध हुने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।

New Delhi: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have jointly inaugurated the Janakpurdham-Ayodhya rail service. Prime Minister Shah and Indian Prime Minister Modi, who are on a state visit to India, inaugurated the rail service today by hoisting the flag virtually. The 604-kilometer distance from Ayodhya to Janakpurdham will be covered by train in about 19 hours. The train service, which will operate through various cities in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, is expected to promote religious tourism and facilitate cross-border movement between the two countries. The train, named 'Janakpurdham-Ayodhya Cantt Express', will enter Nepal via Jayanagar Railway Station in Bihar, India. The train will pick up and drop off passengers at Janakpurdham, Jayanagar, Madhubani, Sisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiyagunj, Gorakhpur, Basti, Mankapur, Ayodhya Dham and Ayodhya Cantt stations. The train service will operate in both directions once a week. The train number for Janakpurdham to Ayodhya Cantt is 15595 and the train number for Ayodhya Cantt to Janakpurdham is 15596. The train from Janakpurdham to Ayodhya is scheduled to depart at 1:10 pm on Saturday and reach Ayodhya Cantt on Sunday morning. Similarly, the train departing from Ayodhya Cantt at 5:50 pm on Monday will reach Janakpurdham at 12:40 pm on Tuesday. Since the timings at Nepalese railway stations are 15 minutes ahead of Indian time, passengers will need to check the schedule according to local time. Ayodhya is the birthplace of Lord Ram and Janakpur is the birthplace of Goddess Sita, both of which hold religious significance. The new train service is expected to benefit religious tourists, relatives, students, and businessmen, as well as boost the tourism industry. Previously, there was a provision that passengers traveling from India to Janakpurdham by train had to change trains to Nepal after reaching Jayanagar in Bihar and completing border procedures. The new service is expected to provide the facility to continue traveling on the same train after completing the necessary border checks.
